note: ACT-SCIENCE-AGENT-RELEASE.prereg.md: the batch split, fixed before any packet is built. One batch = two sibling cohorts written to the same brief (80 items, 14 passages), so a grader sees the cross-item patterns a shared brief produces. Each batch gets TWO fresh graders (g1, g2); single-grader flags go to ONE fresh re-check grader per batch (r1) over only the flagged items. `seed` deals the option order (keys flat A/B/C/D per batch); it is fixed here so the deal cannot be re-rolled after a grader has seen it.
